UPDATE efficiency_equipment_info
positive_rate = #{positiveRate},
display_name = #{displayName},
expected_annual_income = #{expectedAnnualIncome},
expected_check_number_people = #{expectedCheckNumberPeople},
dept_expected_payback_period = #{deptExpectedPaybackPeriod},
WHERE asset_uid IN
#{item}
mapper.select: with assets as ( SELECT ai.uid, ai.tenant_uid, ai.institution_uid,ai.hospital_uid,ai.site_uid, ai.clinical_dept_uid from asset_info ai JOIN user_org uo ON uo.org_uid IN (ai.tenant_uid, ai.institution_uid, ai.hospital_uid, ai.site_uid, ai.clinical_dept_uid) WHERE uo.user_uid = #{userUID} AND ai.is_valid AND NOT ai.is_deleted ) select distinct oi.uid,oi.name,oi.short_name from efficiency_equipment_info eei left join assets ai on eei.asset_uid=ai.uid left join org_info oi on ai.clinical_dept_uid=oi.uid where ai.tenant_uid=#{tenantUid} and (ai.tenant_uid=#{siteUid} or ai.institution_uid =#{siteUid} or ai.hospital_uid=#{siteUid} or ai.site_uid=#{siteUid} or ai.clinical_dept_uid=#{siteUid} )
